items.heading: Module 5: AI Foundations: People & Talent
items.paragraph:
This module discusses the importance of understanding different types of AI organizations and their talent needs for making informed decisions about an organization's AI strategy. It explores the key competencies required for AI talent, particularly in the critical role of data scientist, and discusses the collaborative effort required from various teams. The module also presents three main avenues for developing an AI-ready workforce.

items.heading: Heading
items.paragraph: This video discusses three organization types: AI innovators, AI implementers, and AI adopters, and explains their different talent requirements. The video also emphasizes the need to cultivate a diverse talent pool by actively recruiting or contracting experienced AI talent and training existing staff to become responsible users of AI.

items.title: The GSA's AI Guide for Government suggests that having AI practitioners report directly to program office leaders helps ensure:

answers.feedback: The guide emphasizes aligning AI with policy priorities, not technology trends

items.heading: Heading
items.paragraph: This video discusses three main avenues for developing an AI-ready workforce: training existing staff, hiring new talent, and seeking outside assistance. It explains the advantages and considerations associated with each approach. The video also emphasizes the importance of creating roles and structures that signal to data scientists that they will be doing meaningful work and the need to prioritize diversity and rigorously evaluate skills when building an AI team.

items.title: According to the passage, what must public sector organizations do to attract AI talent like data scientist? Select all that apply.

answers.title: Create roles that signal to data scientists they will be doing meaningful AI work
Offer salaries that are competitive with the private sector
Develop structures that indicate AI talent will be able to utilize their skills effectively

items.feedbackCorrect: The passage states that to attract AI talent, public sector organizations must create roles that signal to data scientists they will be doing meaningful AI work and develop structures that indicate AI talent will be able to utilize their skills effectively
items.feedbackIncorrect: The incorrect answers, B and C, are not supported by the information provided, as the passage does not mention competitive salaries or rapid career advancement opportunities as necessary actions for attracting AI talent
